card.name: Old-text citations and 1700s dates
card.fires_on: Punctuation and linking words inside lists of names, dictionary headwords, and the digit 7 in 1700s years, in old historical or reference texts.

modes.label: Publisher lists
modes.description: The comma or 'and' within a list of publisher names in a book citation.
modes.example: Longman, Rees, Orme, Brown,<< and>> Green. Retrieved 5 October 2

modes.label: Years in the 1700s
modes.description: The digit 7 after '1' in an eighteenth-century year.
modes.example: passed in 1<<7>>85 prohibiting the sale of slaves imported

modes.label: Dictionary entries
modes.description: Punctuation or the part-of-speech mark right after a headword in an old dictionary entry.

card.writes: Weak, mixed effect; it slightly favors words like 'basic' and 'techniques'.
card.plain: It fires on small pieces of old reference text, such as publisher lists, dictionary entries, and 1700s years.
